name: set_selected_object_motion_blend

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectMotionBlend consumes two values, packs the first value's low 24 bits and the second value as a float into a type-17 object-operation record, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: The embedded object-operation name table labels type 17 MOTTION_BLEND. ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectMotionBlend targets the selected object at Script offset 0 and supplies the encoded animation ID and blend duration to that operation. Command 57 immediately before it queues type 16 MOTION_OFF, while command 95 commonly precedes it after restoring the object's default motion resource. The JP corpus contains 296 calls.
